activity.action: Complete one fictional handover document using the prepared inventory. Review the three decisions; a fresh-clone rerun is optional.
activity.expected_result: The document matches the exact fictional project, input, setup and expected result. Neither checker executes the document command or certifies real access.

questions.feedback: A revision identifies code, not the input or permission to use it. Find the approved input and verify the successor's own access; never transfer a personal login.

options.label: Locate or transfer the required input through the owner-approved route, verify access, and record its identity.
The code revision is enough; the successor can recreate the original input.
Put the departing researcher's personal login in the document.

questions.prompt: The handover names an exact code revision and an environment file, but its only input copy is on the departing researcher's laptop. What must be resolved before claiming the project is recoverable?

questions.feedback: Exit code 0 only means this command completed. It does not prove the expected result. Investigate the mismatch before changing a reference result.

options.label: No. Compare the revision, input identity and environment, resolve the mismatch, then rerun.
Yes. Exit code 0 proves the expected result.
Change the expected total to 13 without investigating.

questions.prompt: The synthetic command exits with code 0 and prints measurements=3 total=13. The handover says measurements=3 total=12. Can you record reproduction as successful?

questions.feedback: A successful rerun does not make its inputs disposable. Confirm temporary-copy ownership, approval and the review date; retain the approved source and records.

options.label: Only the temporary cache in scratch/; retain the approved source and required records.
Both folders, because the rerun passed.
Delete scratch/ now without checking its owner or schedule.

questions.prompt: A verified rerun used inputs/measurements.csv, the only approved source copy. scratch/ contains a disposable calculation cache. What can the cleanup plan name for removal after owner approval and its scheduled review?

recipe.intro: Use only the supplied fictional project. No personal accounts, real paths or datasets belong in this exercise.

steps.expected: The worksheet and fictional inventory are available.
steps.instruction: Press Prepare practice folder. It prepares the worksheet and a separate fixed project, and shows its actual revision. Open workspace/handover/project-handover.md in the practice folder.
steps.on_failure: Preserve any existing or altered folder and request help; do not replace it with real project files.
steps.on_success: Read the inventory before filling the worksheet.
steps.title: Prepare the fictional handover

steps.expected: Distinguish required source/input/setup from recreated local state.
steps.instruction: The supplied inventory contains verify.py, inputs/measurements.csv and environment.json. The environment declares Python 3.9 or newer, with no external packages. scratch/ and .venv/ are temporary and are not in the transfer.
steps.on_failure: A complete-looking document is insufficient if its named files cannot be obtained.
steps.on_success: Compare each handover field with the inventory.
steps.title: Find what the successor needs

commands.command:
Repository: local fictional fixture

Revision: 4e45a59f4a09d7c069d8af34b5d724f7c7c513cf

Main approved data location: inputs/measurements.csv

Temporary locations to remove: scratch/

Environment definition: environment.json

Expected result: measurements=3 total=12

Setup command: python3 -m venv --without-pip .venv

Verification command: ./.venv/bin/python -I verify.py
commands.disclosure: Show setup and verification fields for macOS or Linux

commands.command:
Setup command: python -m venv --without-pip .venv

Verification command: & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -I verify.py
commands.disclosure: Show setup and verification fields for Windows

steps.expected: The document describes only this fixed project and states what remains unverified.
steps.instruction: Keep each label once on its own line. Choose fictional owners and a limitation. Copy the inventory revision and file identities, then record the setup and verification commands for your operating system. Use a valid future planned deletion date for the fictional temporary copy.
steps.on_failure: Do not invent access or claim a run that you did not observe.
steps.on_success: Review the document before checking it. Do not claim a personal rerun if you use the supplied observation.
steps.title: Complete the fictional handover

steps.expected: The fresh clone prints measurements=3 total=12. Compare both values and the exit status.
steps.instruction: If Git and Python 3.9+ already work, open Optional: reproduce in a fresh clone under the prepared inventory. Review and run that generated command. Stop on an existing target; the original project and your terminal directory stay unchanged.
steps.on_failure: You can use the supplied observation for this packet without claiming a personal run. Do not install Python solely for this optional task.
steps.on_success: An environment is recreated, not copied. Record only the result personally observed.
steps.title: Optional: try a fresh clone

steps.expected: A successful command and a reproduced result are different claims.
steps.instruction: The maintainer's fresh-clone observation is measurements=3 total=12. A deliberately changed input prints measurements=3 total=13 even though the command exits successfully. Decide what the handover should claim.
steps.on_failure: Do not change the expected result merely to make a check appear successful.
steps.on_success: Use the questions to choose the next action for a mismatch.
steps.title: Decide whether the result matches

steps.expected: The next person can reproduce again after temporary work is retired.
steps.instruction: The fictional information owner must retain inputs/measurements.csv. Only scratch/ is named in the temporary-copy plan. Keep an access owner, retention owner, future review date and one unresolved limitation. This exercise grants no approval to delete or revoke access.
steps.on_failure: For a real unresolved ownership or retention decision, stop and contact the project owner privately.
steps.on_success: Review the packet and answer the three decisions.
steps.title: Separate retained inputs from temporary copies
